semiconductor_relevance: High — IR Vision develops advanced infrared detectors that are integral for various semiconductor applications, particularly in sensing and measurement.
summary: IR Vision specializes in high-sensitivity photonic infrared detectors utilizing proprietary Quasi Photo-Dember (QPD) technology. Their products enable room-temperature operation and are designed for integration into systems for applications such as gas sensing, portable spectroscopy, and industrial monitoring.
capabilities: Broadband spectral response from 400 nm to 3.5 μm
High infrared sensitivity without thermoelectric cooling

regional_presence.Taiwan: IR Vision is showcasing its products at SEMICON Taiwan 2026, indicating a strategic focus on this market.
